label: Click power
description: Resources gained by one production click, before resource multipliers. Click-power achievements raise it permanently, and it appears on every production-click factor list.

label: Auto-click rate
description: Automated production clicks generated every second. Dev Tools set the current rate; bonuses are planned to feed it once upgrades target this stat.

label: Building cost multiplier
description: Multiplies every building's base cost before growth and other discounts. Starts at ×1; lower is cheaper. Master Builder milestones reduce it cumulatively to ÷2, ÷3, through ÷8. Does not affect upgrade prices.

label: Army power
description: Combined fighting strength of every owned unit, summed from each stack's attack, accuracy, armour and hit points. Shown on both army headers in battle.
